principle: Option snapshots may be stored live while reconstructible candles are fetched later, provided the join is point-in-time safe.
rules: Use option snapshot observed_at as the decision-time anchor.
Include only candles whose full interval completed at or before observed_at.
Normalize all timestamps to Asia/Kolkata before comparison.
Preserve option expiry separately; do not infer option expiry from the futures contract used for price context.
Reject/flag stale candle context rather than forward-filling it.
Historical candle retrieval time is irrelevant; candle event-time controls eligibility.
